title: Graveler Climbs Up Just to Roll Back Down
premise: Graveler climbs mountains while eating rocks, then rolls all the way back down.
audiencePromise: Watch Graveler turn one mountain climb into a rock-eating round trip.
openLoop: Why does Graveler climb all the way up?
payoff: The summit is not the destination. It is the starting line for Graveler's descent.
engagementQuestion: Is this brilliant efficiency, or the strangest commute?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and playfully. Punch the words climb, rocks, summit, and back down. Build tension uphill, then land the final either-or question with a brief pause.

scenes.headline: UPHILL. THEN DOWNHILL.
scenes.narration: Graveler climbs mountains just to roll back down.
scenes.caption: ONE ENORMOUS ROUND TRIP

scenes.headline: DINNER IS UNDERFOOT
scenes.narration: At the mountain's base, Graveler starts climbing while crunching rocks.
scenes.caption: THE UPHILL TRIP STARTS WITH A MEAL

scenes.headline: THE MOUNTAIN IS FOOD
scenes.narration: The climb doubles as dinner, because rocks are its favorite food.
scenes.caption: ROCKS ARE GRAVELER'S FAVORITE FOOD

scenes.headline: THE SUMMIT ISN'T THE END
scenes.narration: At the summit, Graveler curls up and rolls straight back down.
scenes.caption: SUMMIT REACHED. DESCENT ACTIVATED.

scenes.headline: NOTHING GETS A DETOUR
scenes.narration: It rolls downhill, ignoring obstacles and building momentum on mountain paths.
scenes.caption: OBSTACLES ARE JUST THINGS TO ROLL OVER

scenes.headline: BEST ROUTINE EVER?
scenes.narration: Is this brilliant efficiency, or the strangest commute?
scenes.caption: BRILLIANT ROUTINE OR WASTED CLIMB?
